x: The circle drawn round the reciter: Ikhlāṣ and the two refuges, the Fātiḥa, the opening of al-Baqara, the Throne Verse and the two closing verses, the Ḥadīd and Ḥashr passages and the verse of dominion — then the lettered oaths with their counts, and the archangels and the four Companions named at the close.

بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ✽ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ العَلِيِّ العَظِيمِ ✽ بِكَ مِنْكَ إِلَيْكَ ✽ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ ✽ فَاغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ ✽ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ ✽

Bismi llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm ✽ wa-lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʿAliyyi l-ʿAẓīm ✽ bika minka ilayk ✽ astaghfiruka wa-atūbu ilayk ✽ fa-ghfir lī wa-tub ʿalayy ✽ lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu mina ẓ-ẓālimīn ✽

In the name of Allāh, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. There is no power and no strength save by Allāh, the Most High, the Magnificent. By You, from You, to You. I ask Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance — so forgive me and turn to me. There is no god but You; glory be to You, I was among the wrongdoers.
﴿ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ✽ قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ ✽ اللهُ الصَّمَدُ ✽ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ✽ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴾ ✽
Bismi llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm ✽ qul huwa llāhu aḥad ✽ Allāhu ṣ-Ṣamad ✽ lam yalid wa-lam yūlad ✽ wa-lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad ✽
In the name of Allāh, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. Say: He is Allāh, One. Allāh, the Eternally Besought. He did not beget, nor was He begotten. And there is none comparable to Him.

﴿ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ✽ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ✽ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ✽ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ✽ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ ✽ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴾ ✽
Bismi llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm ✽ qul aʿūdhu bi-Rabbi l-falaq ✽ min sharri mā khalaq ✽ wa-min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab ✽ wa-min sharri n-naffāthāti fī l-ʿuqad ✽ wa-min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad ✽

In the name of Allāh, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. Say: I take refuge with the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He has created; and from the evil of the darkness when it gathers; and from the evil of those who blow upon knots; and from the evil of an envier when he envies.

﴿ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ✽ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ✽ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ✽ إِلٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ✽ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ✽ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ✽ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ ﴾ ✽
Bismi llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm ✽ qul aʿūdhu bi-Rabbi n-nās ✽ Maliki n-nās ✽ Ilāhi n-nās ✽ min sharri l-waswāsi l-khannās ✽ alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri n-nās ✽ mina l-jinnati wa-n-nās ✽

In the name of Allāh, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. Say: I take refuge with the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the slinking whisperer who whispers in the breasts of mankind — from among the jinn and mankind.

﴿ بِسْمِ ٱللهِ ٱلرَّحْمٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ✽ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ ✽ ٱلرَّحْمٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ✽ مَٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ ✽ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ✽ ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ ✽ صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ﴾ ✽

Bismi llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm ✽ al-ḥamdu li-llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn ✽ ar-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm ✽ Māliki yawmi d-dīn ✽ iyyāka naʿbudu wa-iyyāka nastaʿīn ✽ ihdinā ṣ-ṣirāṭa l-mustaqīm ✽ ṣirāṭa lladhīna anʿamta ʿalayhim ghayri l-maghḍūbi ʿalayhim wa-lā ḍ-ḍāllīn ✽

In the name of Allāh, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. Praise be to Allāh, Lord of the worlds; the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful; Master of the Day of Judgement. You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help. Guide us upon the straight path — the path of those You have favoured, not of those upon whom is anger, nor of those who go astray.

﴿ الم ذٰلِكَ الكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ هُدًى لِلْمُتَّقِينَ ✽ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَٰوةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ ✽ وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ وَبِالآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ ✽ أُولٰئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ المُفْلِحُونَ ﴾ ✽

Alif Lām Mīm ✽ dhālika l-kitābu lā rayba fīhi hudan li-l-muttaqīn ✽ alladhīna yuʾminūna bi-l-ghaybi wa-yuqīmūna ṣ-ṣalāta wa-mimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn ✽ wa-lladhīna yuʾminūna bi-mā unzila ilayka wa-mā unzila min qablika wa-bi-l-ākhirati hum yūqinūn ✽ ulāʾika ʿalā hudan min rabbihim wa-ulāʾika humu l-mufliḥūn ✽

Alif Lām Mīm. That is the Book, in which there is no doubt — a guidance for the God-fearing: those who believe in the unseen, and establish the prayer, and spend of what We have provided them; and who believe in what has been sent down to you and what was sent down before you, and are certain of the Hereafter. Those are upon guidance from their Lord, and those are the ones who prosper.

﴿ وَإِلٰهُكُمْ إِلٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الرَّحْمٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ ✽ اللهُ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الحَيُّ القَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَٰوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَٰوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ العَلِيُّ العَظِيمُ ﴾ ✽

Wa-ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥid, lā ilāha illā huwa r-Raḥmānu r-Raḥīm ✽ Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-Ḥayyu l-Qayyūm, lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun wa-lā nawm, lahu mā fī s-samāwāti wa-mā fī l-arḍ, man dhā lladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnih, yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wa-mā khalfahum, wa-lā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin min ʿilmihi illā bi-mā shāʾ, wasiʿa kursiyyuhu s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, wa-lā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā, wa-huwa l-ʿAliyyu l-ʿAẓīm ✽

And your God is One God; there is no god but He, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. Allāh — there is no god but He, the Living, the Self-Subsisting. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is there that can intercede with Him except by His leave? He knows what lies before them and what lies behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except as He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation does not weary Him. And He is the Most High, the Magnificent.

﴿ آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ المَصِيرُ ✽ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ✽ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ✽ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ✽ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ✽ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ✽ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ✽ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى القَوْمِ الكَافِرِينَ ﴾ ✽

Āmana r-rasūlu bi-mā unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wa-l-muʾminūn, kullun āmana bi-llāhi wa-malāʾikatihi wa-kutubihi wa-rusulih, lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadin min rusulih, wa-qālū samiʿnā wa-aṭaʿnā ghufrānaka rabbanā wa-ilayka l-maṣīr ✽ lā yukallifu llāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā ✽ lahā mā kasabat wa-ʿalayhā mā ktasabat ✽ rabbanā lā tuʾākhidhnā in nasīnā aw akhṭaʾnā ✽ rabbanā wa-lā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahu ʿalā lladhīna min qablinā ✽ rabbanā wa-lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih ✽ wa-ʿfu ʿannā wa-ghfir lanā wa-rḥamnā ✽ anta mawlānā fa-nṣurnā ʿalā l-qawmi l-kāfirīn ✽

The Messenger believes in what has been sent down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. Each believes in Allāh, His angels, His books and His messengers — we make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say: we hear and we obey; Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the journey’s end. Allāh charges no soul beyond its capacity: for it is what it has earned, and against it what it has brought upon itself. Our Lord, take us not to task if we forget or fall into error. Our Lord, lay not upon us a burden such as You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, burden us not with what we have no strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us, have mercy upon us. You are our Protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

﴿ سَبَّحَ لِلهِ مَا فِي السَّمَٰوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَهُوَ العَزِيزُ الحَكِيمُ ✽ لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَٰوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ✽ هُوَ الأَوَّلُ وَالآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ ✽ هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَٰوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى العَرْشِ ✽ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ✽ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَمَا كُنْتُمْ ✽ وَاللهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ ✽ لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَٰوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَإِلَى اللهِ تُرْجَعُ الأُمُورُ ✽ يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ ✽ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ ﴾ ✽

Sabbaḥa li-llāhi mā fī s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, wa-huwa l-ʿAzīzu l-Ḥakīm ✽ lahu mulku s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, yuḥyī wa-yumīt, wa-huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr ✽ huwa l-Awwalu wa-l-Ākhiru wa-ẓ-Ẓāhiru wa-l-Bāṭin, wa-huwa bi-kulli shayʾin ʿalīm ✽ huwa lladhī khalaqa s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma stawā ʿalā l-ʿarsh ✽ yaʿlamu mā yaliju fī l-arḍi wa-mā yakhruju minhā wa-mā yanzilu mina s-samāʾi wa-mā yaʿruju fīhā ✽ wa-huwa maʿakum aynamā kuntum ✽ wa-llāhu bi-mā taʿmalūna baṣīr ✽ lahu mulku s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ wa-ilā llāhi turjaʿu l-umūr ✽ yūliju l-layla fī n-nahāri wa-yūliju n-nahāra fī l-layl ✽ wa-huwa ʿAlīmun bi-dhāti ṣ-ṣudūr ✽

All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allāh, and He is the Mighty, the Wise. His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He gives life and gives death; and He has power over all things. He is the First and the Last, the Outward and the Inward, and He is Knower of all things. He it is who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then established Himself upon the Throne. He knows what enters the earth and what comes out of it, what descends from the sky and what ascends into it. And He is with you wherever you are; and Allāh sees what you do. His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allāh all matters are returned. He makes the night pass into the day and the day pass into the night; and He knows what is within the breasts.

﴿ هُوَ اللهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَالِمُ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ هُوَ الرَّحْمٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ ✽ هُوَ اللهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ المَلِكُ القُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ المُؤْمِنُ المُهَيْمِنُ العَزِيزُ الجَبَّارُ المُتَكَبِّرُ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ✽ هُوَ اللهُ الخَالِقُ البَارِئُ المُصَوِّرُ لَهُ الأَسْمَاءُ الحُسْنَىٰ ✽ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَٰوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَهُوَ العَزِيزُ الحَكِيمُ ﴾ ✽

Huwa llāhu lladhī lā ilāha illā huwa, ʿālimu l-ghaybi wa-sh-shahādah, huwa r-Raḥmānu r-Raḥīm ✽ huwa llāhu lladhī lā ilāha illā huwa, al-Maliku l-Quddūsu s-Salāmu l-Muʾminu l-Muhayminu l-ʿAzīzu l-Jabbāru l-Mutakabbir, subḥāna llāhi ʿammā yushrikūn ✽ huwa llāhu l-Khāliqu l-Bāriʾu l-Muṣawwir, lahu l-asmāʾu l-ḥusnā ✽ yusabbiḥu lahu mā fī s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, wa-huwa l-ʿAzīzu l-Ḥakīm ✽

He is Allāh, other than whom there is no god: Knower of the unseen and the seen. He is the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. He is Allāh, other than whom there is no god: the King, the All-Holy, the Peace, the Granter of security, the Guardian, the Mighty, the Compeller, the Supremely Great. Glory be to Allāh above what they associate with Him. He is Allāh: the Creator, the Maker, the Fashioner. To Him belong the most beautiful Names. All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Him; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

﴿ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ مَالِكَ المُلْكِ تُؤْتِي المُلْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتَنْزِعُ المُلْكَ مِمَّنْ تَشَاءُ ✽ وَتُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشَاءُ بِيَدِكَ الخَيْرُ ✽ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ✽ تُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ ✽ وَتُخْرِجُ الحَيَّ مِنَ المَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ المَيِّتَ مِنَ الحَيِّ ✽ وَتَرْزُقُ مَنْ تَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ ﴾ ✽

Quli llāhumma Mālika l-mulk, tuʾtī l-mulka man tashāʾu wa-tanziʿu l-mulka mimman tashāʾ ✽ wa-tuʿizzu man tashāʾu wa-tudhillu man tashāʾ, bi-yadika l-khayr ✽ innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr ✽ tūliju l-layla fī n-nahāri wa-tūliju n-nahāra fī l-layl ✽ wa-tukhriju l-ḥayya mina l-mayyiti wa-tukhriju l-mayyita mina l-ḥayy ✽ wa-tarzuqu man tashāʾu bi-ghayri ḥisāb ✽

Say: O Allāh, Owner of all dominion — You give dominion to whom You will and take dominion from whom You will; You exalt whom You will and abase whom You will. In Your hand is all good. You have power over all things. You make the night pass into the day and the day pass into the night; You bring forth the living from the dead and the dead from the living; and You provide for whom You will without reckoning.

بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ✽ سَلَامٌ قَوْلًا مِنْ رَبٍّ رَحِيمٍ ✽ قَوْلُهُ الحَقُّ وَلَهُ المُلْكُ ✽ مَرَجَ البَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ ✽ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَا يَبْغِيَانِ ✽ كهيعص ✽ حمعسق ✽ الر ✽ ن ✽ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ (٧) طا ✽ ﴿ إِنْ نَشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ آيَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خَاضِعِينَ ﴾ ✽ حَكَّمْتُ عَلَىٰ أَنْفُسِ أَعْدَائِي الطَّاءَ ✽ طَهُورُ (٧) ✽ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ (٧) ✽ سَلَامٌ قَوْلًا مِنْ رَبٍّ رَحِيمٍ ✽ قَلْقَلْتُ عُقُولَهُم بِالقَافِ ✽ بَدَعَقٌّ (٧) ✽ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ (٧) ✽

Bismi llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm ✽ salāmun qawlan min Rabbin Raḥīm ✽ qawluhu l-ḥaqqu wa-lahu l-mulk ✽ maraja l-baḥrayni yaltaqiyān ✽ baynahumā barzakhun lā yabghiyān ✽ Kāf Hāʾ Yāʾ ʿAyn Ṣād ✽ Ḥāʾ Mīm ʿAyn Sīn Qāf ✽ Alif Lām Rāʾ ✽ Nūn ✽ Allāhu akbar (×7) Ṭā ✽ in nashaʾ nunazzil ʿalayhim mina s-samāʾi āyatan fa-ẓallat aʿnāquhum lahā khāḍiʿīn ✽ ḥakkamtu ʿalā anfusi aʿdāʾiya ṭ-ṭāʾ ✽ Ṭahūrun (×7) ✽ lā ilāha illā llāh (×7) ✽ salāmun qawlan min Rabbin Raḥīm ✽ qalqaltu ʿuqūlahum bi-l-qāf ✽ Badaʿaqqun (×7) ✽ subḥāna llāh (×7) ✽

In the name of Allāh, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. “Peace” — a word from a Merciful Lord. His word is the truth, and His is the dominion. He let loose the two seas, meeting together; between them a barrier they do not overpass. Kāf Hāʾ Yāʾ ʿAyn Ṣād · Ḥāʾ Mīm ʿAyn Sīn Qāf · Alif Lām Rāʾ · Nūn. (Allāh is greatest — seven times.) Ṭā. If We will, We send down upon them a sign from the sky, before which their necks stay bowed. I have set the ṭāʾ in judgement over the souls of my enemies. (Ṭahūrun — seven.) (There is no god but Allāh — seven.) “Peace” — a word from a Merciful Lord. I have shaken their minds with the qāf. (Badaʿaqqun — seven.) (Glory be to Allāh — seven.)

﴿ سَبَّحَ لِلهِ مَا فِي السَّمَٰوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَهُوَ العَزِيزُ الحَكِيمُ ✽ لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَٰوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ✽ هُوَ الأَوَّلُ وَالآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالبَاطِنُ ✽ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ ✽ هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَٰوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى العَرْشِ ✽ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ✽ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَمَا كُنْتُمْ وَاللهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ ﴾ ✽

Sabbaḥa li-llāhi mā fī s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, wa-huwa l-ʿAzīzu l-Ḥakīm ✽ lahu mulku s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, yuḥyī wa-yumīt, wa-huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr ✽ huwa l-Awwalu wa-l-Ākhiru wa-ẓ-Ẓāhiru wa-l-Bāṭin ✽ wa-huwa bi-kulli shayʾin ʿalīm ✽ huwa lladhī khalaqa s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma stawā ʿalā l-ʿarsh ✽ yaʿlamu mā yaliju fī l-arḍi wa-mā yakhruju minhā wa-mā yanzilu mina s-samāʾi wa-mā yaʿruju fīhā ✽ wa-huwa maʿakum aynamā kuntum wa-llāhu bi-mā taʿmalūna baṣīr ✽

All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allāh, and He is the Mighty, the Wise. His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He gives life and gives death; and He has power over all things. He is the First and the Last, the Outward and the Inward, and He is Knower of all things. He it is who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then established Himself upon the Throne. He knows what enters the earth and what comes out of it, what descends from the sky and what ascends into it. And He is with you wherever you are; and Allāh sees what you do.
حَاءُ فَتَحْتُ بَابَ الِاسْتِمْطَارِ مِنَ الفَتَّاحِ العَلِيمِ (٧) ✽
Ḥāʾu: fataḥtu bāba l-istimṭāri mina l-Fattāḥi l-ʿAlīm (×7) ✽
Ḥāʾ: by it I have opened the door of the drawing-down of rain from the Opener, the All-Knowing. (Seven times.)
يَا سَلَامُ (٧) ✽ سَلَبْتُ بِالسِّينِ عَنْ نَفْسِي وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي وَوَلَدِي جَمِيعَ المَضَارِّ ✽ صُوَرَه (٧) ✽ الحَمْدُ لِلهِ (٧) ✽ عَيْنٌ مَلَأَتْ قَلْبِيْ عِزَّةً وَنُورًا ✽ مُحْبِبُهُ (٧) ✽
Yā Salāmu (×7) ✽ salabtu bi-s-sīni ʿan nafsī wa-ahlī wa-mālī wa-waladī jamīʿa l-maḍārr ✽ Ṣuwarahun (×7) ✽ al-ḥamdu li-llāh (×7) ✽ ʿAynun malaʾat qalbī ʿizzatan wa-nūran ✽ Muḥbibuhun (×7) ✽

O Peace — seven times. By the sīn I have stripped away from myself, my family, my property and my child every harm. (Ṣuwarahun — seven.) (Praise be to Allāh — seven.) ʿAyn: it has filled my heart with might and with light. (Muḥbibuhun — seven.)
يَا سَلَامُ (٧) ✽ سِينٌ أَسْأَلُكَ بِالسَّنَاءِ الأَعْظَمِ أَنْ تُعْطِيَنِي مِفْتَاحَ قَلْبِي ✽ سَقْفَاطِيسْ (٧) ✽ اللهُ (٧) ✽
Yā Salāmu (×7) ✽ sīnun: asʾaluka bi-s-sanāʾi l-aʿẓam an tuʿṭiyanī miftāḥa qalbī ✽ Saqfāṭīsun (×7) ✽ Allāh (×7) ✽
O Peace — seven times. Sīn: I ask You by the greatest radiance that You give me the key of my heart. (Saqfāṭīsun — seven.) (Allāh — seven.)

رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ ✽ رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ حَوْلًا مِنْ حَوْلِكَ ✽ وَقُوَّةً مِنْ قُوَّتِكَ ✽ وَتَأْيِيدًا مِنْ تَأْيِيدِكَ ✽ حَتَّىٰ لَا أَرَىٰ غَيْرَكَ ✽ وَلاَ أَشْهَدَ سِوَاكَ ✽

Rabbi aʿūdhu bika min hamazāti sh-shayāṭīni wa-aʿūdhu bika Rabbi an yaḥḍurūn ✽ Rabbi asʾaluka ḥawlan min ḥawlik ✽ wa-quwwatan min quwwatik ✽ wa-taʾyīdan min taʾyīdik ✽ ḥattā lā arā ghayrak ✽ wa-lā ashhada siwāk ✽

My Lord, I take refuge in You from the promptings of the shayāṭīn, and I take refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me. My Lord, I ask You for a power from Your power, and a strength from Your strength, and a support from Your support, until I see none but You and witness none besides You.
سَقَاطِيمٌ (٧) ✽ أَحُونٌ قَافُ أَدُمَّ حم هَاءُ آمِينٌ ✽
Saqāṭīmun (×7) ✽ Aḥūnun Qāfun Adummun Ḥā-Mīm Hāʾun Āmīnun ✽
(Saqāṭīmun — seven.) Aḥūnun · Qāfun · Adummun · Ḥā Mīm · Hāʾun · Āmīnun.

﴿ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللهِ ✽ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ أَشِدَّاءُ عَلَى الكُفَّارِ رُحَمَاءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ✽ تَرَاهُمْ رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِنَ اللهِ وَرِضْوَانًا ✽ سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ مِنْ أَثَرِ السُّجُودِ ✽ ذٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ ✽ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِي الإِنْجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ فَآزَرَهُ فَاسْتَغْلَظَ فَاسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِ يُعْجِبُ الزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ الكُفَّارَ ✽ وَعَدَ اللهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنْهُمْ مَغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا ﴾ ✽

Muḥammadun rasūlu llāh ✽ wa-lladhīna maʿahu ashiddāʾu ʿalā l-kuffāri ruḥamāʾu baynahum ✽ tarāhum rukkaʿan sujjadan yabtaghūna faḍlan mina llāhi wa-riḍwānan ✽ sīmāhum fī wujūhihim min athari s-sujūd ✽ dhālika mathaluhum fī t-Tawrāh ✽ wa-mathaluhum fī l-Injīli ka-zarʿin akhraja shaṭʾahu fa-āzarahu fa-staghlaẓa fa-stawā ʿalā sūqihi yuʿjibu z-zurrāʿa li-yaghīẓa bihimu l-kuffār ✽ waʿada llāhu lladhīna āmanū wa-ʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti minhum maghfiratan wa-ajran ʿaẓīmā ✽

Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh; and those with him are firm against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating, seeking bounty from Allāh and good pleasure; their mark is upon their faces from the trace of prostration. That is their likeness in the Torah, and their likeness in the Gospel: as a seed that puts forth its shoot, then strengthens it, so that it grows thick and stands firm upon its stalk, delighting the sowers — that through them He may enrage the disbelievers. Allāh has promised those of them who believe and do righteous deeds forgiveness and a great reward.

اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَجِبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ وَعِزْرَائِيلَ وَالرُّوحِ ✽ عَلَيْهِمُ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ ✽ وَبِحَقِّ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ الفَارُوقِ ✽ وَعُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَانَ وَعَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ✽ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمْ ✽ أَنْ تَقْضِيَ حَاجَتِي وَتَكْفِيَنِي مُهِمَّاتِي [وَتُسَمِّي حَاجَتَكَ] ✽

Allāhumma bi-ḥaqqi Muḥammadin wa-Jibrāʾīla wa-Mīkāʾīla wa-Isrāfīla wa-ʿIzrāʾīla wa-r-Rūḥ ✽ ʿalayhimu ṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salām ✽ wa-bi-ḥaqqi Abī Bakrin wa-ʿUmara l-Fārūq ✽ wa-ʿUthmāna bni ʿAffān wa-ʿAliyyi bni Abī Ṭālib ✽ raḍiya llāhu ʿanhum ✽ an taqḍiya ḥājatī wa-takfiyanī muhimmātī [wa-tusammī ḥājatak] ✽

O Allāh, by the right of Muḥammad, Jibrāʾīl, Mīkāʾīl, Isrāfīl, ʿIzrāʾīl and the Spirit — blessings and peace be upon them — and by the right of Abū Bakr, ʿUmar al-Fārūq, ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān and ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib — may Allāh be pleased with them — fulfil my need and suffice me in my weighty affairs. [And here you name your need.]

اللَّهُمَّ يَا عَظِيمُ عَظَمَتُكَ وِقَايَتِي مِنَ القَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ ✽ وَجَمَالِي عَلَى العَالَمِينَ ✽ فَاعْضُدْنِي بِالمَلَائِكَةِ أَجْمَعِينَ ✽ وَاسْتَجِبْ لِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ العَلِيمُ ✽ وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ ✽

Allāhumma yā ʿAẓīmu, ʿaẓamatuka wiqāyatī mina l-qawmi ẓ-ẓālimīn ✽ wa-jamālī ʿalā l-ʿālamīn ✽ fa-ʿḍudnī bi-l-malāʾikati ajmaʿīn ✽ wa-stajib lī innaka anta s-Samīʿu l-ʿAlīm ✽ wa-ṣallā llāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi wa-sallam ✽

O Allāh, O Magnificent: may Your magnificence be my safeguard from the wrongdoing people, and my beauty before the worlds. Sustain me with all the angels, and answer me — You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. And may Allāh bless our master Muḥammad, his family and his Companions, and grant them peace.
Ḥizb al-Dāʾira — 21 bands. Imām Abū al-Ḥasan al-Shādhilī, d. 656 AH / 1258 CE.
